notes: Monday to Friday Mass now has its own section with a priest for each day, Saturday Mass is always English, and the language reminders now cover Sunday only.
new: The Monday to Friday Mass Schedule moved from Home to its own Mon-Fri section in the bottom bar. Crew: between Home and Chapel. Priest and founder: between Home and Users Status.
Each weekday shows which priest celebrates the Mass. The priest and founder can rename Priest 1, Priest 2 and Priest 3 and assign a priest to each day.
The priest and founder can now also tick Chapel preparation tasks.
changed: The language of the Saturday Mass is always English. Only the Sunday language is set by the priest or founder.
Language reminder notifications and the Home reminder card now apply to Sunday only.
